questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a network topology?
questions.explanation: Star, ring and mesh are network topologies; disk is a storage device.

questions.question: Storage capacity of magnetic disk depends on
questions.explanation: Disk capacity depends on track density (tracks per inch), recording density (bits per inch along a track) and the number of disk surfaces in the pack, so all of these. Choosing only bits per inch ignores the other factors.

questions.question: TPDU (Transport Protocol Data Unit) refers to:

options.A: A unit of data in the physical layer
options.B: A unit of data in the data link layer
options.C: A unit of data in the transport layer
options.D: A unit of data in the network layer

questions.explanation: A TPDU (Transport Protocol Data Unit) is the data unit exchanged at the transport layer (segment). Frames belong to the data link layer and packets to the network layer.

questions.question: The Internet of Things (IoT), access to real-time data, and the introduction of cyber-physical systems mark the big changes for this era:
questions.explanation: Industry 4.0 (the fourth industrial revolution) is characterised by IoT, cyber-physical systems and real-time data. The 3rd industrial revolution was about electronics and computers.

questions.question: Which term describes the way devices are interconnected in a network?
questions.explanation: Topology is the arrangement or interconnection pattern of devices in a network (bus, star, ring, mesh). Bandwidth is the data-carrying capacity.

questions.question: What is a session in web development?

options.B: A way to store data on the client side
options.C: A temporary storage for user-specific data during a browsing session
options.D: A method to encrypt data for secure transmission

questions.explanation: A session temporarily stores user-specific data (usually on the server) across multiple requests during a browsing session. Client-side storage describes cookies, not sessions.

questions.question: Which of the following applications are included in the Strategic Computing Program?
questions.explanation: DARPA's Strategic Computing Program (1983) targeted three flagship applications: the Autonomous Land Vehicle, the Pilot's Associate and Battle Management. So all of the listed applications are included.

questions.question: Which one of the following is the correct definition of the "is_array();" function in C++?

options.A: It checks that the specified variable is of the array or not
options.B: It checks that the specified array is of single dimension or not
options.C: It checks that the array specified is of multidimension or not
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: std::is_array checks whether the given type is an array type. It does not check the number of dimensions (that is std::rank).

questions.question: What is internet?

options.B: A vast collection of different networks

questions.explanation: The internet is a vast global collection of different interconnected networks (a network of networks), not just LANs.

questions.question: What does the DOM represent in web development?
questions.explanation: DOM stands for Document Object Model, a tree representation of an HTML/XML document that scripts can read and modify.

questions.question: Select the true statement for compiler.

options.A: The input of the compiler is source program.
options.B: It translates the source code into object code as a whole.
options.C: The output of the compiler is object code.
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: All three statements are true: a compiler takes the source program as input, translates it as a whole, and produces object code as output. Hence more than one option is correct.

questions.question: A threaded binary tree is a binary tree in which:

options.B: Each node has at most one child
options.C: Each node is connected to its parent
options.D: Each node has a thread connecting it to its predecessor or successor

questions.explanation: In a threaded binary tree, null child pointers are replaced by threads pointing to the in-order predecessor or successor, enabling traversal without a stack. Structure (number of children) is not changed.

questions.question: In Python, ________ module needs to be imported for implementing a double-ended queue.
questions.explanation: deque is provided by the collections module (from collections import deque). Counter is itself a class in collections, not a module.

questions.question: Hyperlinks can be created between a Word document and

options.C: A webpage on a company intranet

questions.explanation: A Word hyperlink can point to another document, a page on the WWW or a page on a company intranet, so all of these are valid targets.

questions.question: In an ideal microcomputer, where is the Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU) located?
questions.explanation: The ALU is part of the CPU (microprocessor), along with the control unit and registers. Memory only stores data and instructions.

questions.question: Which implementation of a stack requires a fixed amount of memory allocated for a fixed number of elements?
questions.explanation: An array-based stack reserves a fixed-size block of memory, so it can hold only a fixed number of elements. A linked implementation grows dynamically node by node.

questions.question: Which of the following is the original creator of the C++ language?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Bjarne Stroustrup created C++ at Bell Labs. Dennis Ritchie created C, and Ken Thompson created B and co-created Unix.

questions.question: SQL views are also known as

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: A view is a stored query whose result looks like a table but does not physically store data, so it is called a virtual table.

questions.question: The kernel operates in a privileged mode, also known as:
questions.explanation: The kernel runs in kernel mode, also called supervisor (privileged) mode, where all instructions are allowed. User mode is the restricted mode for applications.

questions.question: Audio compression can be used for____________
questions.explanation: Audio compression is applied to speech or music. Video, pictures and colours are handled by video/image compression.

questions.question: Which maintenance process model focuses on fixing defects as they are identified?
questions.explanation: Corrective maintenance fixes faults reported after delivery. Adaptive maintenance adapts to environment changes and perfective maintenance adds improvements.

questions.question: RFID is used for?
questions.explanation: RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) uses radio waves to automatically identify and track tagged objects. It does not provide Wi-Fi or 3G connectivity.

questions.question: In a half-adder circuit, what are the outputs?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: A half adder adds two bits and produces a Sum (XOR) and a Carry (AND). Difference and Borrow are the outputs of a half subtractor.

questions.question: A regular language over an alphabet ∑ is closed under the following operation(s):
questions.explanation: Regular languages are closed under union, concatenation and Kleene star (and also intersection, complement, etc.).

questions.question: What is the primary function of routing in the network layer?

options.C: Finding the best path for data

questions.explanation: Routing at the network layer determines the best path for packets from source to destination. Framing and flow control belong to the data link layer.
